app.synthetic: SYNTHETIC DATA ONLY: NOT FOR CLINICAL USE
app.offline: You are offline. Showing the last saved view.

onboarding.welcome_body: {{doctor}} has set up this app for you. It shows how your sugar may change and simple things that can help.
onboarding.otp_body: We sent a 6-digit code to your phone.
onboarding.consent_purpose: Purpose: to show you and your care team how your sugar may change in the next 2 hours.
onboarding.consent_data: What is used: your sensor readings, sleep, steps, and what you log in this app.
onboarding.consent_who: Who sees it: you and {{doctor}}'s care team. Nobody else.
onboarding.consent_rights: Your rights: see who viewed your data, change language, and withdraw at any time.
onboarding.consent_synthetic: This is a demo with simulated (synthetic) data. It is not medical advice.
onboarding.choice_share_logs: Share my food and activity logs with my doctor
onboarding.choice_caregiver: Allow a family member to see my status
onboarding.tour_1: Your status: a simple colour, an icon and a sentence tell you how your sugar is doing.
onboarding.tour_2: Log in one tap: meals, walks and medicines help your twin learn about you.
onboarding.tour_3: Try it: see what a walk or a different meal could do. These are estimates.
onboarding.wearable_body: Demo: your sugar sensor and watch are simulated.

try.title: Try it
try.subtitle: See what could help. These are estimates from your twin.

q.walk15: What if I walk 15 minutes now?
q.roti_rice: What if I eat roti instead of rice?
q.early_dinner: What if I have dinner earlier?

log.title: Quick log
log.saved: Saved! Your twin will update in a few minutes.
log.med_note: Medicine questions? Message your doctor. The app never changes your medicine.

me.withdraw_confirm: This stops the app and all data sharing now. Continue?
